confusions: Barrow Field menu showed 'exits: N S' and 'go north (locked)' but the actual unlock options were 5 and 6 (force/search). The displayed exit list vs the menu options didn't align clearly.
Sodden Verge suddenly showed exit 'S - Antler Stake' that hadn't been mentioned before. New exits appearing without prior hint felt inconsistent.
Side paths (vault east, crypt down) in Antechamber said 'skip them and skip only plunder, not progress' but never explained what those plunder items actually were or whether they had any value.
suggestions: Display all exits consistently upfront rather than revealing them as player moves; reduces disorientation
Add story consequences for choosing between 'seal barrow' (reeve) vs 'open barrow' (priest) paths
Develop the crown path equally; it felt like an alternative route that wasn't fully explored
Label hostile NPCs more carefully—the Hollow King was hostile but only needed dialogue, not combat
Add flavor text briefly describing side-area loot even if player skips it, so choices feel informed
